behavior: Onboarding has its own address, /app/onboarding, instead of replacing whatever /app page was opened
acceptance: A signed-in user whose onboarding is not done is sent from any /app page to /app/onboarding, keeping the page they asked for; Continue or Skip takes them there (or to /app), only to a same-site /app path
A user who finished or skipped onboarding and opens /app/onboarding is sent to /app; reload and the back button keep the user on the right page; the page title names onboarding
e2e covers a new user opening /app/invoices: they land on /app/onboarding, finish it and arrive at /app/invoices; and an onboarded user opening /app/onboarding lands on /app
notes: 2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Pass. Ran lint, tsc, unit (128 passed), docs-check (0 errors), e2e (51 + 41 passed, exit 0). Mutation: removing the /app regex or the onboarding exclusion in afterOnboarding each fails the unit test. Browser probe on the dev server as an onboarded user: javascript:, /app\evil, //evil, https://evil all go to /app; a 4000-char next works; nothing leaves the origin. Non-blocking: afterOnboarding (features/onboarding/lib/onboarding.ts:98) accepts dot segments, so next=/app/../../pay/0x1 lands on /pay/0x1 and /app/..//evil.example/x lands on same-origin /evil.example/x. Same site only, no open redirect, but the docs and accept 1 say an /app path only. Fix: resolve with new URL(next, base), check the pathname, and return pathname+search. Redirect flow checked: signed out, loading, me error, profile switch, reload with and without next, back button: no loop. The freelancer profile still opens after Continue (e2e). page.tsx imports only constants.

2026-10-15 review fail by independent reviewer: Fail. dccac12 fixes the dot-segment bypass: /app/../pay, /app/..//evil, /app/%2e%2e/pay, backslashes and javascript: now all resolve to /app; the onboarding unit tests pass (9 of 9). New defect: afterOnboarding (apps/web/src/features/onboarding/lib/onboarding.ts:101) calls new URL(next, base), which throws TypeError ERR_INVALID_URL for a malformed next such as 'http://[', '//[' or 'https://a:b' (checked in node). It runs inside the app-shell effect (app-shell.tsx:83) with no catch, so an onboarded user who opens /app/onboarding?next=http://%5B gets an uncaught error instead of /app. Anyone can send that link. Smallest fix: const url = URL.parse(next || APP_ROUTES.home, base); return url && url.origin === base && ...; or wrap new URL in try/catch and return APP_ROUTES.home on error. Add 'http://[' to the blocked list in the unit test. Everything else from the first review still holds.

2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Pass. 2a1ed48 wraps new URL in try/catch in afterOnboarding (apps/web/src/features/onboarding/lib/onboarding.ts:101-106), so a malformed next such as http://[ or //[ returns /app instead of throwing in the app-shell effect. The unit test now blocks both values; without the catch new URL throws and the test fails. The onboarding unit tests pass (9 of 9). dccac12 still resolves .., //, encoded dots, backslashes and javascript: to /app. The earlier findings (redirect flow, freelancer landing, page.tsx imports, e2e 51 + 41 passed) still hold. Full e2e not run again, as asked.
